name: dsnr
description: Local coordination layer over real Flock product repositories.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.viewer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.check:static: prettier --check . && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.extension:package: node extension/build.mjs && cd extension && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --skip-license --out dsnr.vsix
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs boot
scripts.smoke:page: npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs page
scripts.smoke:local: npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs local
